facts.fact: The U.S. International Trade Administration reports that the government is drafting a Digital Transformation Strategy covering connectivity, e-government and social services (note dated 2025-07-16, which is also the as_of date).

The U.S. International Trade Administration reports that in December 2024 the government launched the Internet for All project, aiming to raise internet access from under 25% to 100% of the population by 2030, with a period running to 2030.
